resources.string: Fetches up to 10 distinct keyboxes from the two fixed upstream feeds. Select one, then apply to replace the software engine keybox using the existing import command. This does not provision hardware TEE. Revocation and attestation acceptance are unknown; certificate dates do not establish either. Applying pauses automatic keybox replacement to retain your choice. Total user count: unknown (no generic public endpoint).
Available: %1$d / 10 distinct keyboxes. Upstream may publish fewer than 10.
Certificate window: %1$s — %2$s (earliest expiry across the chain)
Local checks: XML, private-key match, chain signatures, and certificate dates passed. Root trust and revocation are not established.
Imported successfully. The CLI validated the keybox and backed up the previous file if present. This does not confirm hardware attestation acceptance.
Import failed or certificate dates changed. Check root access, the installed ta-enhanced CLI, network access for CLI validation, and the device clock. No command output or private key is shown.
Could not fetch the keybox pool. Check network access and the device clock.
